page.content:
Buddha's Western temple where the scriptures are granted.

How Thunderclap Monastery connects

  • Character: Buddha — The Buddha grants the texts at Thunderclap Monastery.
  • Location: Western Heaven — Thunderclap Monastery is the scripture-house of the Western Heaven.
  • Faction: Tang pilgrimage — The pilgrims' road ends at Thunderclap Monastery.

What is Thunderclap Monastery?

Thunderclap Monastery on Vulture Peak is the pilgrimage's goal: the Buddha's seat, the blank and then true scriptures, and the disciples' final appointments.

Key threads lead to Buddha, Western Heaven and Tang pilgrimage.
